title: Dashboard Preference Change
description: One preference event. `prefix` and `bindings` customize the keymap whose defaults are described by the sibling `⌨️keymap` schema; a binding id is `<scope>.<action>` and its keys replace the default keys of that binding.

PrefixKey.description: A key the terminal tells from typing: held with ctrl or alt, or a named key.

Key.description: Zero or more `ctrl+`, `alt+`, `shift+` modifiers, then one printable character or a lowercase key name (enter, esc, tab, backtab, backspace, delete, insert, up, down, left, right, home, end, pageup, pagedown, space, f1 to f24).
